Gross margin null: not meaningful for a bank (cost of funding/credit losses). Net cash null: bank balance sheet (deposits $45.3B) not comparable. Customer concentration null: 20-F FY25 says no single customer represented 10% or more of revenues. TTM diluted EPS $0.7343 = H1'26 0.3936 + FY25 0.5846 - H1'25 0.2439; prior TTM 0.4697. ev_ntm_sales = forward P/S from stockanalysis (bank EV not meaningful). China exposure: none material identified. Founder-led: David Vélez, founder & CEO.
